body.content: Challenge: Strict determinism implies evidence is a pure function of the problem input. If so, displacement of completed evidence is only a performance concern (recompute) unless the process ingested non-reproducible oracle inputs. The entire reclamation safety problem may reduce to whether the workspace boundary includes hidden non-determinism.
body.why_keep_this: Reframes the safety guarantee as either a strong consensus problem or a weak caching problem, depending on the scope of determinism; tests the premise that evidence is intrinsically irreplaceable.
